text:
Maya (CS): Heads up — Acme workshop tomorrow 10am PT. We should hand them a one‑pager: quick runbook for cache/batch/stream ops + renewal-risk flags to watch. Who can pull something together?

Alex (Eng): I can draft a runbook focused on operational knobs. Will include batching config, cache TTL guidance, and safe fallback patterns. Any customer constraints?

Maya (CS): Acme uses short-turnaround queries, heavy embedding calls and occasional spikes from ingestion pipelines. They want low tail latency and graceful degradation during bursts.

Alex (Eng): Ok — plan:
- Prefill KV caches for login flows
- Soft limits + immediate fallback to smaller model for spikes
- Batching: keep batch window <= 20ms for low-latency paths, use larger windows for async jobs
Will add command snippets.

Sam (AE): Add a short "what to monitor" list for CS/AE: token cost delta, p95 latency, cache hit rate, user error spike that correlates with model fallbacks.

Jordan (PM): Also include enablement checklist for onboarding: test prompt set, a smoke test script, and renewal watch triggers (e.g., usage drop >30% in 7d).

Nina (CSE): I'll add a preflight checklist for their SREs — sample nginx + client config and a small cURL smoke test:
```
# check streaming endpoint
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"input":"ping"}'
```

Alex (Eng): Draft in Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=example_doc — feedback welcome. I'll add a "safe mode" snippet:
```
if (latency_p95 > 500) {
  route_to("compact-quantized");
  enable_kv_prefill(true);
}
```

Maya (CS): Love it. Can someone also write a short paragraph we can share with procurement about Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs for renewals?

Sam (AE): On it — 1 paragraph comparing cost predictability vs flexibility, and the SLA/penalties to mention.

ops-bot: Uploaded: /drive/Acme-Runbook-v1.pdf :page_facing_up: (shared with @acme-sre@acme.com)

Maya (CS): Great — reviewers: @Jordan (PM) @Alex (Eng) @Nina (CSE). Aim for final by EOD today so we can print for the workshop. :thumbsup: 

Jordan (PM): Ack, I'll review comments by 3pm.

Alex (Eng): will do a quick pass at lunch, then push updates.

Maya (CS): Thanks team — this will help with onboarding + reduce renewal risk by showing we've got operational playbooks.
